states: Gautier Cloix is the Chief Executive Officer of Twinlink. He spent a decade at Palantir, supporting the firm’s growth first across Europe and then globally.

A graduate of Centrale and the X-HEC Entrepreneurs program, Gautier began his career at JPMorgan in London before turning to social entrepreneurship. He joined Palantir in 2015, established and led its French office, and steered strategic public sector and enterprise engagements with organisations including Airbus. His work helped make Paris a major hub for the company and grow Foundry into one of its flagship platforms.
Most recently, Gautier was based in New York, where he led the worldwide rollout of AIP, Palantir’s generative AI platform. He now leads Twinlink, focused on scalable, enterprise-ready AI.

states: Géraldine Lafontaine is Chief Operating Officer at Twinlink, leading the Go-To-Market, Finance, and Operations teams. She has more than 15 years of operational leadership experience across investment banking and high-growth technology.

Before Twinlink, Géraldine spent three years at Birdie Care in London, scaling finance and operations teams in preparation for rapid growth. Prior to that, she spent over six years at Palantir Technologies, overseeing software deployments for major European enterprises and government agencies while building commercial and go-to-market capabilities.
She began her career at Goldman Sachs and Credit Suisse in New York and London. Géraldine holds an M.Eng. from CentraleSupélec and an MA in Mathematics of Finance from Columbia University.

states: Laurent Sifre is Chair of the Scientific Committee at Twinlink. He holds degrees from École Polytechnique and École des Ponts et Chaussées, and earned a PhD in applied mathematics under Professor Stéphane Mallat.

Laurent began his research career with an internship at Google Brain in 2013 and joined DeepMind as a Research Scientist in 2014. Over nine years, he contributed to major projects including AlphaGo, AlphaFold, AlphaStar, and language models at Google such as Chinchilla, RETRO, Gemma, and Gemini.
In early 2024, Laurent left Google to co-found Twinlink, a company building autonomous AI systems.
